Magmakinesis.title: Magmakinesis
Magmakinesis.description: You have obtained the power to manipulate and control magma

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{magma:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Magmakinesis","color":"#610e00","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}

Secondary.Ability.title: Magmaball
Secondary.Ability.description: Shoot out a ball of magma. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

Transform.Unlock.title: Magma Coating
Transform.Unlock.description: Coat your arms in magma, increasing damage and destructiveness

Lavabeam.Unlock.title: Lava Beam
Lavabeam.Unlock.description: Shoot out a beam of lava

Molten.Absorb.Unlock.title: Molten Absorption
Molten.Absorb.Unlock.description: Absorb magma, lava and fire around you, fueling your power

Erupt.Unlock.title: Erupt
Erupt.Unlock.description: Erupt lava in the direction you are facing

Erupt.title: Erupt
commands_on_block_hit: execute if score Gamerule EOP.Non.Destructive.Mode matches 0 run execute unless block ~ ~-0.6 ~ bedrock run fill ~1 ~1 ~1 ~-1 ~-1 ~-1 lava[level=15] replace #eop:air
execute if score Gamerule EOP.Non.Destructive.Mode matches 0 run execute if block ~ ~-0.6 ~ bedrock run fill ~1 ~1 ~1 ~-1 ~ ~-1 lava[level=15] replace #eop:air
execute if score Gamerule EOP.Non.Destructive.Mode matches 0 run summon tnt
execute if score Gamerule EOP.Non.Destructive.Mode matches 1 run particle minecraft:explosion ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1
execute if score Gamerule EOP.Non.Destructive.Mode matches 1 run playsound minecraft:entity.generic.explode master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1
